verdict.rationale: Fern's 'Ask Fern' feature lets end users ask natural-language questions against docs with citations, and the Fern Agent/MCP server enables agent-driven, prompt-based automation (e.g., scheduled prompts that review feedback and open PRs). However, this is more about consuming/querying docs and automating doc maintenance via natural language than an AI-native user 'operating the product' (e.g., managing SDKs, API definitions, deployments) end-to-end via NL commands — the core CLI/config workflows remain structured commands/YAML, not conversational. missing for 10: evidence that core Fern operations (SDK generation, API definition editing, publishing) can be driven by natural-language prompts rather than CLI flags/config files, and independent/hands-on confirmation of Fern Agent's NL command scope.
